## Your journey

{{< include /guidance/_partials/diagram-journey-critical-friend.qmd >}}

## What you are confirming

Confirm that:

- appropriate and sufficient quality assurance has taken place for the level the work is at
- the use of the outputs is appropriate: the results can carry the decision they will be used for
- the assumptions and risks are understood

You give advice. The commissioner owns the decision and the analyst owns the analysis.

## How independent you have to be

The assurer and the analyst shall be independent. How far apart depends on the level.

| Level | The critical friend is |
|---|---|
| Level 1 Standard | A colleague, within the delivering team |
| Level 2 Enhanced | Someone who was not involved in producing the work. They may be in the delivering team |
| Level 3 Comprehensive | An assurer from outside the delivering team |
| Level 4 BCA | A Lead Assurer from outside the delivering team, with external review |

: How independent the critical friend must be, by assurance level

Level 4 BCA is the Business Critical level. See [Business Critical analysis](../08-business-critical/index.qmd).

## If time is short {#if-there-is-not-enough-time}

If there is not enough time for the checks your level requires, say so plainly. See [where a disagreement goes](index.qmd#when-you-disagree).
